cues.text: A cook in a black apron over a striped shirt stands at a white kitchen table. A wooden bowl holds flour. A glass pitcher, a small jar, a metal bowl, a rolling pin, and a cutting board sit nearby.

She pours lukewarm water from the pitcher into the flour, mixing with both hands until a shaggy dough forms. She kneads it in the bowl with a black-gloved hand, then lifts the cohesive ball onto the wooden board. She sprinkles flour around it from a small bowl.

She arranges the dough balls in a row on the mat, presses one flat, and rolls it into a long thin oval with the wooden pin. She brushes oil from a small bowl onto the rolled dough, then spreads it evenly with the pin.

She sprinkles flour from the glass container onto the oiled dough, folds it in half lengthwise, and rolls it tightly into a spiral. She continues rolling the strip into an even log and sets it down on the floured mat.

She rolls the dough back and forth with the wooden pin, flattening it into a thin circle. She lifts the pin, turns the dough over with one hand, and resumes rolling it thinner. On-screen text appears listing sizes from 12 to 24 inches.
